messages:
Maria: heads-up — kicking off engine bundle rollout for quant-v3b -> v3.1.0 during the night window (00:30-04:30). canary slice: 1% EU-west first.
Cheng: copy. are we pinning customer routes for the first 2 hours like last time?
Maria: yes, pin TTL=2h. release notes draft: https://internal/redwood/release/quant-v3.1.0/draft
Noah: quick FYI from prebake: 2 of 20 canaries reported elevated kernel OOM counts and a spike in token-p95 (~1.3x). logs attached.
Maria: show logs snippet:
```
2026-03-21T00:42:10Z engine[pid:1249]: kernel: ABI mismatch detected
expected kernel.abi=13, found kernel.abi=12
dropping module: signature-check failed
```
Noah: looks like packaging used an older driver bundle for EU-west prebake machines.
deploy-bot: release quant-v3.1.0 canary start -> slice=eu-west-1%, job=engine-canary(3789)
Cheng: can we pin back the canary to previous image while we triage? prefer not a full rollback yet.
Maria: I'm holding rollouts. deploy-bot: pin request received for route:engine/* -> image:quant-v3b@sha256:OLD
Tim (oncall): assigning infra to check prebake image registry and packaging pipeline.
Noah: I pulled artifact metadata, build meta shows driver_sha=abcd1234 but staging expects efgh5678.
Cheng: probable cause: release CI skipped the driver rebuild due to cache hit. we need a quick rebuild with fresh driver signing.
Maria: rollback criteria proposal:
- if >3% of canaries in region show OOM or p95 > baseline * 1.2 for 5m => immediate abort
- any ABI/signature mismatch in logs => abort
- deployment error rate > 0.5% for 10m => rollback
Noah: agree. also add: if deploy-bot flags packaging checksum mismatch => abort automatically.
deploy-bot: note: checksum mismatch alerting is enabled for this release (alerts: packaging.checksum, kernel.abi).
Maria: action items:
- @Cheng re-run packaging with driver_sha=efgh5678, bump bundle tag, update release notes (link above)
- @Noah verify prebake on 5 EU-west machines and post thermal/oom counters
- @Tim (oncall) keep drain threshold ready if we need to pull traffic
Cheng: starting rebuild now, will post new bundle sha in ~15m
Noah: prebake smoke run queued once new bundle is pushed
Maria: good. hold current pin until we confirm prebake green. if green -> resume canary with 0.5% and 30m observation windows.
Tim (oncall): I'll watch alerts and escalate if any cross-region spillover.
Cheng: new bundle pushed: quant-v3.1.0-driverfix@sha256:zzzz9999
Noah: running prebake smoke... results in 8m: all green, p95 back to baseline, no OOMs in sample.
Maria: ok resume plan: unpin canary, resume at 0.5% EU-west for 30m, then 2% global if stable. keep rollback criteria active.
deploy-bot: resume command accepted by Maria. scheduled canary: start in 5m.
Noah: postmortem note: add packaging CI cache invalidation for driver artifacts to release checklist.
Maria: agreed. drafting release note update and changelog item now. :+1:
Tim (oncall): thanks all — stay tuned, will call if we need emergency rollback.
thread_summary: canary showed ABI/driver packaging mismatch causing OOMs; team held rollout, rebuilt driver bundle, prebaked, and resumed a staged canary with stricter criteria.
